Ready to merge. The merging session read the full diff (one test file, 12 lines; the author is a different agent).

- `ring_plan()` returns a reference to one `LazyLock` value. The three tests and the ignored probe read it; none changes it. The asserts and their values are the same; two calls change `&ring` to `ring` because the value is a reference now.
- The `#[test]` count is the same (5, one ignored). No file of the library changes.
- Author's readings: the three tests pass; the plan is computed one time (3 times before); wall time at 6 threads is the same (8.5 s), CPU time goes down by about 13 s for each run of the lib binary. clippy for the motion lib is clean.
- `git merge-tree` with main `fa81b91b6` is clean. No trial build ran here: the change is in one test module and does not reach library code.

The PR is flagged ready for the merge. Nothing is pushed after this flag.
